field.label: Max Tool Response Tokens
field.comment: Tool output larger than this estimated token count is truncated before it is sent to the AI, so one large result cannot crowd out the conversation (default: 4000).

field.label: Customer E-mail Interval (minutes)
field.comment: Mago e-mails the customer of an order at most once in this many minutes, so a repeated or bulk request cannot flood the customer's inbox. 0 removes the limit (default: 60).
